rejection_reason: PARK (status parked), re-measured 2026-10-30. Infrastructure blocker, not a data judgement: neither the coordinator network nor an EU (Helsinki) worker can read the portal - api.data.gov.in refuses TCP from both, and the www edge returns 503 because it cannot reach its origin. DNS is correct on both networks (same A records via the local resolver and dns.google), so this is not the coordinator resolver artifact seen on other sources. Not a rejection: data.gov.in is a large live catalog and nothing about its data is known to be unusable; only access from every network this project controls is blocked.
next_action: Closed on access, not on merit. Reopen only on new access evidence: (a) a network class with Indian routing (first GET of https://data.gov.in/api/ or the catalog page answers whether the portal is live), (b) independent evidence that the portal is publicly reachable again (e.g. a third-party uptime record), or (c) a licence-bearing third-party mirror of the catalogue. On reopen, run the same enumeration: API-enabled datasets via the catalog API, task families absent from the bench (EXCLUDING station-level air quality, which cpcb-aqi-exceedance owns), and read the GODL-India licence claim for CPCB resources on api.data.gov.in (still unverified; cpcb-aqi-exceedance remains dropped until that grant is read).
